title: A2 Media portfolio: B2B SaaS video examples
answer: The A2 Media portfolio is a library of real videos we've produced for B2B SaaS teams, from short-form ads and product launches to customer stories, animated explainers, executive talking-head videos and episodic YouTube series. Behind the work are results like $600K in video-attributed closed-won revenue at Reveal, 22K+ new subscribers at Auth0 (Okta) and $900K+ in sponsorships for PartnerHacker.
author: Ademola Adelakun

body.text: Where can you watch A2 Media's work?

The channel below holds real videos we've produced for B2B SaaS teams. Browse it for inspiration, or to see what a format looks like before you brief one internally. Every piece started with the same question: how does this video help close deals?

body.text: What kinds of videos does A2 Media make?
We make any video format a B2B buyer will watch, as long as it maps to a stage of the funnel and a job for your sales team. These are the formats you'll see most in the channel above.

body.text: What results has the work produced?

The videos in the channel are the visible part. The results come from treating them as a system, with each video mapped to a buyer, a funnel stage and a sales use. Here's what that system produced for three clients.

body.label: From the Reveal engagement
body.body: Reveal had no video, no content marketing and no content team. We built their engine from scratch: 100+ videos in 1.5 years across LinkedIn thought leadership, YouTube education, outbound sales enablement, top-of-funnel comedy and webinars, plus a 7,000-attendee virtual summit. Video-attributed deals closed $600K in revenue and time to close dropped 40%.

body.label: From the Auth0 (Okta) engagement
body.body: Auth0's YouTube channel was losing subscribers monthly. We revived it and took them multichannel across YouTube, LinkedIn and TikTok. The result: 22K+ new organic subscribers, 5.2M+ views, and video driving 35% of registrations for the Oktane and Developer Day virtual events.

body.label: From the PartnerHacker engagement
body.body: We were PartnerHacker's first video hire. We produced 50 pieces of content across webinars, podcasts, short clips and full-funnel video, helped host a 5,000-attendee partnerships webinar, and closed $900K+ in sponsorships. PartnerHacker was acquired 8 months after launch.

body.label: What the client said
body.body: "We saw record YouTube numbers in our first month with a2. They helped us create explainer videos, short-form content, and event assets. The team is fast, clear, and genuinely fun to work with. Best video partner we've had in SaaS." Greg Mares, Senior Media Specialist, Okta

body.text: How should you use these examples?

Use them to pick a format for a specific buyer problem, then plan how many videos it takes to move a deal. A single great video rarely closes anything on its own, so read [how many videos it takes to close a B2B deal](/playbook/how-many-videos-to-close-a-deal) before you brief your first one.

And if you're comparing partners, look past the reel. Ask what each video was for and what it did, which is the core of our guide on [how to choose a video agency](/playbook/how-to-choose-a-video-agency).

closing.text: If one of these formats fits a problem your sales team has right now, the full case studies show how we built each engine.
